name: Custom CSS Class to Body
description: Adds custom CSS class(es) to the <body> tag of specific node pages and, optionally, the node's content-type machine name.
project_description: A small, procedural (hook-only) module that lets editors add arbitrary CSS class(es) to the <body> tag of individual node pages. Each node gains two base fields on its edit form: a free-text CSS class field and a checkbox that appends the node's content-type machine name as a body class. A content-type-level textfield (stored as a third-party setting) can add classes to every node of that type. Classes are emitted in hook_preprocess_html(). No plugins, services, routes, permissions or configuration entities of its own.
